name: io.github.pranava0x0/sept11-mcp
title: September 11th Documents
description: Read-only research tools over New York City's September 11th Document Portal: local catalog search, verbatim page text with Bates citations, quote verification, the release watchdog, settlement and DOI obligation rows, and the commitment ledger. Every answer carries its snapshot, evidence state and warnings; nothing is summarized or inferred.

environmentVariables.name: SEPT11_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The checkout that holds the evidence: the publication allowlist, docs/data, captured page text and the accepted catalog snapshots. An installed package serves nothing without it.

environmentVariables.name: SEPT11_ALLOW_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable portal_search, the one tool that sends query terms to the City's portal. Default off: every other tool answers from local captures.

environmentVariables.name: SEPT11_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the shared request budget and fetched bytes live. Defaults to ~/.cache/sept11-mcp.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio.
